### When I Work “Availability” section no longer works

I have the same complaint as many others: The availability section, once functional and easy to understand, is now essentially broken. I noticed the the response to all previous complaints was to go to the help section, so I did. I attempted to fix my availability step by step, as instructed by When I Work, and still I am unable to make changes to my availability. There must be a glitch because no matter what I’m met with the same response, “This preference conflicts with another [date].” Something is messed up, please fix ASAP. My next semester starts very soon and I must update my employer. Thank you.
